justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/ByteCodeAppender.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/ByteCodeAppenderCompoundTest.java`. `Compound` is a small nested class with only 2 constructors and 1 behavior method (`apply`), about 44 source lines total, and its logic is narrowly focused on composing delegate appenders, flattening nested `Compound` instances, and merging returned sizes. The test covers only this delegation/composition behavior. I found no evidence of excessive size, many public methods, or multiple unrelated responsibilities, so insufficient modularization is not present.
